# sigma_deployment_policy_tenant (Resource)

Targets a tenant organization for a deployment policy. Composite ID `<deployment_policy_id>:<tenant_organization_id>`. Look up available tenant orgs with data.sigma_deployment_policy_tenants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Target a tenant org for this deployment policy. Look up
# tenant_organization_id via data.sigma_deployment_policy_tenants.
resource "sigma_deployment_policy_tenant" "acme" {
  deployment_policy_id   = sigma_deployment_policy.prod_rollout.id
  tenant_organization_id = data.sigma_deployment_policy_tenants.all.tenants[0].tenant_organization_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_policy_id` (String)
- `tenant_organization_id` (String) ID of the tenant organization to target.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_deployment_policy_tenant.example '<deployment_policy_id>:<tenant_organization_id>'
```
